title: Introduce model ingest contract validator and cost-footprint hint generator
author: Priya Sharma
description:
Context: onboarding teams frequently supply partial or inconsistent model metadata which makes downstream profile generation, performance budgeting, and changelog automation brittle. This PR introduces a lightweight ingest contract validator (v2 schema) and a new 'cost-footprint' hint generator that derives unit-cost and memory expectations from a combination of declared metadata and sampled runtime signals.

What this PR does: Adds a validation layer that enforces a minimal canonical ingest contract and surface-level diagnostics when fields are missing or ambiguous. When a model passes ingest validation the system now also emits structured 'cost-footprint' hints into the model profile: estimated vRAM at 2048/4096 context lengths, expected per-token latency band on common GPU tiers, and a tokenized-context-size estimate for typical prompts. These hints are conservative by default and are designed to feed Redwood Optimize and rollout tooling.

Design notes: The ingest contract (schema v2) requires: canonical_name, model_size_bytes (or model_size_hint), param_count, architecture_family, supported_quantizations, sample_inputs_hash, and an optional perf_probe pointer. The validator implements schema normalization and a small set of heuristic fillers for missing fields (for example, infer param_count from model_size_bytes when param_count omitted). The cost-footprint generator combines: declared metadata, a small lookup table derived from existing profiled models, and sampled metric aggregates (if a perf_probe is attached) to produce three hint tiers (conservative | expected | optimistic). Hints are stamped with a stability_score and provenance fingerprint to drive changelog automation.

Why this is different: existing onboarding logic performs ad-hoc checks and leaves profiling to separate workflows. This PR consolidates the contract check into the intake path and attaches derived operational hints immediately so downstream systems (Optimize, Dedicated capacity estimators, and changelog writers) can operate earlier in the flow.

Testing and rollout: Unit tests cover schema permutations and inferred-field heuristics. Integration tests run the ingest flow against two synthetic model bundles (small transformer ~200M, and medium ~6B) and assert hint ranges match historical baselines within 20%. A canary rollout gate (feature flag mr.ingest_contract_v2) is added; initial rollout is to staging only, then a controlled production flip for accounts with low-volume onboarding.

Compatibility and migration: The validator is permissive for legacy entries by preserving existing metadata when present. Models that fail strict validation emit actionable lint-style diagnostics exposed in the console and via a new intake API error code (400.INGEST_CONTRACT_V2). There is a migration path documented in the README that shows how to add the minimal fields to pass v2.

Related work: follows discussion from ENG-4215 and references the perf sample format introduced in PM-210.

Notes for reviewers: focus on the heuristic fillers in ingest_validator.py and the cost model lookup table (cost_table.json). Both are intentionally conservative but marked for future calibration via telemetry.

review_comments: Noah Kim (review): Please add a short unit test that covers a model with param_count omitted but model_size_bytes present so we can lock the inference heuristic. Small nit: prefer explicit typing on the validator return type.

Ethan Patel (review): The cost_table.json will need periodic calibration - can we emit a telemetry counter when the hint falls into the 'optimistic' bucket so Optimize can collect drift?

merge_commit_message:
Introduce ingest contract v2 and cost-footprint hints

Squashed-by: Priya Sharma
Linked: ENG-4215
release_notes:
- Add ingest contract v2: canonical_name, model_size_bytes/param_count, architecture_family, supported_quantizations, sample_inputs_hash.
- Emit conservative cost-footprint hints with provenance and stability_score into model profiles to help Optimize and capacity estimators.
- New intake diagnostics and error code 400.INGEST_CONTRACT_V2 for clearer migration guidance.
postmerge_tasks: Schedule calibration job to refresh cost_table.json after 2 weeks of telemetry
Document known edge cases in docs/model-ingest-v2.md
notes_for_release_managers: No blocking migrations. Feature guarded by mr.ingest_contract_v2 flag. Recommend enabling flag for staging tenants for 72h and validate telemetry counters before wide rollout.
